actions.opportunity_summary: AJ Graphy pe lived educator experience laata hai plus product, teaching, creator business models pe systems thinking. Educator onboarding, AI-enabled creator workflows, aur real classroom friction pe grounded product strategy mein help kar sakta hai.
opportunity_bullets: Graphy pe teacher experience hai — real friction pata hai
Educator onboarding + AI workflows shape kar sakte ho
Product strategy teaching + creator business se grounded
why_recommended: Pehle is opportunity ko like kiya tha.
Research brief ready — outreach grounded rahega.
Entry points se clear collaboration path dikhta hai.
Product pe firsthand experience hai — insight se open karo.
Pehle inko reach karo: Product leadership contact (Head of Product).

target_contact.name: Product leadership contact
target_contact.title: Head of Product
target_contact.why_they_matter: Educator workflow feedback + product insight — real teacher experience se pilot ideas.

email.subject: Product leadership contact — opportunity to explore Creator Education Founder in Residence with Graphy
email.body:
Hello Product leadership contact,

I have been following Graphy's work — Graphy India-based creator-economy platform hai — educators, coaches, experts courses, memberships, live learning se monetize karte hain.

Having worked directly in this space, I would value the chance to share a few practical observations that may be useful to your team.

My background spans systems thinking, product strategy, ai transformation, innovation, and I am especially drawn to founder-led environments where ideas, products, and systems can be woven together with clarity and pace.

Would you be open to a short conversation?

Warm regards,
Ankit
